description: This file defines the NsdHelper class, which manages network service discovery, registration, and resolution using Android's NsdManager API for mDNS-based service discovery in an Android application.

classes.name: NsdHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing network service discovery, registration, and resolution using Android's NsdManager API.

methods.name: NsdHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NsdHelper with application context.

methods.name: initializeNsd
methods.description: Initializes the resolve listener for service resolution.

methods.name: initializeDiscoveryListener
methods.description: Sets up the discovery listener to handle service discovery events.

methods.name: initializeResolveListener
methods.description: Sets up the resolve listener to handle service resolution events.

methods.name: initializeRegistrationListener
methods.description: Sets up the registration listener for service registration events.

methods.name: registerService
methods.description: Registers a network service on a specified port.

methods.name: discoverServices
methods.description: Starts discovering network services of a specific type.

methods.name: getChosenServiceInfo
methods.description: Returns the currently resolved service info.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Unregisters the service and cleans up resources.
